reproduction.rationale: Both paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions must reconstruct the same original Figure 1 per-neuron method/variant correlation family and low/high-noise gain companions, with all required original controls and separately named conditions once their source scope is bound. Source-reported 36 f/42 m/39 s and 117 released files do not establish ordered original arrays; Figure 1e OASIS 105 and the distinct Figure 1g 105-finite subset remain separate unresolved observations. The pair needs identical authentic calcium/ephys/cohort/segment/noise inputs and permitted-observation boundaries, original fold/fit and timing/kernel policy, evaluator and complete granular verification, source-equivalent references, independently justified whole-family comparison and uncertainty criteria, and cumulative exposure/resource budgets. Historical evaluation-fitted OASIS/MLSpike and paper-era versus corrected CASCADE must retain their declared source roles. The prepared-rate metric utility and published vectors cannot establish calcium-derived computation or original-source equivalence. Actual source manifests, full-panel closure, submitted-analysis/verifier/comparator identities and those policies are missing, so neither protocol nor reference identity is invented.

improvement.rationale: Both information conditions must assess the same original-condition per-neuron spike-rate Pearson endpoint and source figure reduction, retaining pooled-GC8/variant-specific comparisons, original controls and rate-error safeguards. They need the same authentic observations, neuron/segment/noise and training/evaluation membership, temporal resolution/support, permitted tuning, evaluator, paired baseline outputs, exposure policy and cumulative budgets. The source excluded-neuron CASCADE reference, exact original aggregate, meaningful gain and biological/model/noise uncertainty rule are unresolved. A released all-neuron checkpoint, changed kernel, post-hoc timing shift, reduced cohort, favorable method/noise subset or higher demo score cannot substitute. Historical evaluation-fitted OASIS/MLSpike remain disclosed reproduction comparators; they do not grant a protected improvement candidate access to heldout spike labels. No comparison against the strongest source method or superiority criterion is established by the existing metric utility. Actual common-input, author-code-only addition, evaluation-identity, baseline and policy manifests remain missing, so the pairing protocol stays null.
